paragraphs.text: All business trips must be pre-approved by the department head. Approval requests must be submitted at least 5 business days before the planned departure date.
Accommodation expenses are reimbursed up to $250 per night for domestic travel and $350 per night for international travel. Receipts are required for all claims.
Meal per diem is $35 per day for domestic travel and $50 per day for international travel. No receipts needed for per diem claims.
Transportation costs including flights, trains, and taxis are fully reimbursable. Business class is permitted for flights over 6 hours.
Fuel reimbursement for personal vehicle use during business travel is capped at 60 litres per trip. Mileage rate is $0.72 per kilometre.
Employees may claim reimbursement for approved professional development courses up to $5,000 per financial year.
Conference attendance costs including registration fees, travel, and accommodation are reimbursable upon submission of an expense report.
Online course subscriptions and certification exam fees are eligible for reimbursement with manager approval.
Training reimbursement requires submission of completion certificate or proof of attendance.
Office equipment purchases over $500 require prior approval from the department head.
Standard workstation setup includes a laptop, monitor, keyboard, and mouse. Upgrades must be approved by IT.
Software licenses and subscriptions must be procured through the IT department. Direct purchases are not reimbursable.
Client entertainment expenses up to $150 per person are reimbursable with itemised receipts.
Gifts to clients or partners must not exceed $100 per recipient per occasion. Cash gifts are strictly prohibited.
Corporate card use for personal purchases is prohibited. Any personal charges must be reimbursed within 30 days.
The corporate card is to be used exclusively for business-related expenses. Personal use is strictly prohibited.
All corporate card transactions must be reconciled within 30 days of the statement date.
Cash advances via corporate card are not permitted. Suspicious transactions will be flagged for review.
Lost or stolen cards must be reported immediately. Cardholders are liable for unauthorised transactions until reported.
Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Late submissions may result in delayed reimbursement.
Receipts are required for all expenses over $25. Digital copies are accepted.
All expense reports must be approved by the direct manager before processing.
Foreign currency transactions must be reported in the original currency with the exchange rate used.
Employees using personal vehicles for business purposes are reimbursed at $0.72 per kilometre.
Fuel costs are reimbursed up to 60 litres per trip. Receipts must be provided.
Tolls and parking fees incurred during business travel are fully reimbursable with receipts.
Remote employees may claim reimbursement for home office setup up to $1,000 per year.
Internet and phone allowances are $50 per month for partially remote staff and $100 per month for fully remote staff.
Relocation expenses including moving services, temporary accommodation, and travel are reimbursed up to $15,000.
Rent assistance of up to $500 per month is available for 3 months following relocation.
Purchases over $10,000 require three competitive quotes and procurement committee approval.
Emergency purchases without prior approval are limited to $5,000 per occurrence.
All procurement must follow the approved vendor list. Exceptions require procurement manager approval.
All expense reports are subject to random audit. Audit selection is risk-based.
Falsified expense claims will result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
Employees must disclose any personal interest in a supplier or vendor before engaging in procurement.
Accepting gifts or favours from suppliers valued over $50 must be reported to compliance.
Financial statements and internal data must not be shared with external parties without authorisation.
Data breaches or suspected information leaks must be reported to IT security within 1 hour.
Cash withdrawals disguised as discounts, service fees, or refunds are considered fraud and will be investigated.
Any transaction involving cash-back, cash-out, or ATM withdrawal on corporate cards must be pre-approved.
Conference attendance requires manager approval and must be directly relevant to the employee's role.
Travel, accommodation, and registration for approved conferences are fully reimbursable.
Standard office supplies (stationery, paper, ink) are provided by the office manager and should not be expensed individually.
Specialised equipment or furniture requires facilities team approval before purchase.
